reviews.text: Best dog trainer ever! We've been training our puppy with Teca for a month now, and the difference is clear. I'm so happy to see the positive results of the training and, even more so, to see my puppy growing up and being well-behaved. Teca is a great professional, very attentive to her students and owners. I recommend her without hesitation!

I had the pleasure of being Teca's student in the dog training course and I can say it was a unique experience!

Besides being an exemplary professional and attentive teacher, Teca is an incredible human being, empathetic and understanding!

I highly recommend her work!
Excellent professional! In just a few lessons, we've already seen results that we thought would take months to achieve. Very competent and empathetic with animals. I recommend her without hesitation!

Excellent work done by Teca from Descãoplicado. She explained my dogs' behavior and how I should create training strategies to improve our relationship. She provided educational materials and offered support after the consultation. I recommend her.
Professional service and my dog ​​was already using the training pad to relieve herself in just one day.

Teca has been amazing training my beautiful yet formerly disobedient dog Rio! She understand animals and how they think and their psychology on a level comparable with the professionals you see on TV like the Dog Whisperer etc. Although I think Teca is better, and should have her own show. Shes great to work with and communicates well. Best dog trainer ive ever encountered and would 100% recommend!
Teca is excellent. In just one visit, she demonstrated considerable knowledge of animal science and psychology, and we've already noticed a difference in our dogs' behavior.

Wonderful service, extremely competent professional, knows the canine world inside and out.

In addition, Teca is a very kind and caring person with both dogs and humans. I highly recommend her!
A wonderful professional with fantastic knowledge. I always recommend her to people who ask me.
Teca is wonderful. She takes exemplary care of her animal. And she teaches us a lot about how to train our pets.

Excellent! Teca is very knowledgeable and provides a solid foundation for all her training instructions. My little French Bulldog, who was considered "difficult to train," adapted very well and learned very quickly!

I highly recommend her service!

Teca Marinho trained my dog ​​Freddy, a Golden Retriever, before he was one year old. Today, at 8 years old, I still see how important that training was. She is a very competent and loving professional. The excellent quality training, with a very good cost-benefit ratio, gives us a lot of confidence in handling our four-legged friend.
Teca is an excellent professional and her tips are proving invaluable in training my dog.
Thanks!
Wonderful! Teca is an animal charmer, highly competent, caring, dedicated, loving, and she gave us all the confidence in the world. Our Chica loves her!!!!
With love and discipline, the best trainer we've worked with on this far from straightforward path of dog training! Teca, you made all the difference in our lives!! Thank you!!!!

I used the training services for my two dogs and I really liked them. I also still use the boarding service. Teca is a serious and very competent professional, and she loves animals. The way she handles dogs is exceptional. I highly recommend her!

Teca is the most professional person I know in this field, very loving with animals and at the same time firm when needed… right away you can see how well she understands animal behavior and guides you very well in everything you need 👏🏻👏🏻 …

I love Teca Marinho!!!
She managed to train my Chow Chow. At the time, she was 6-7 years old and was quite aggressive, wary of many people. Teca has a lot of knowledge in the field and even trains other dog trainers. Besides that, she's a fantastic person!
I finally understood that we can't treat our furry friends like normal human beings. They have special needs.
I just want to thank you all for your kindness towards Greg.
Excellent trainer. She did wonders for my dogs. 😃 …

Wonderful! At the time, my two dogs were fighting, and I was quite desperate because of the sudden change in their behavior. In 4 or 5 training sessions, in addition to receiving guidance on how to handle them, they both started playing and sleeping together again.
Excellent professional. My son Thor was trained by her to urinate on the training pad and always do his business in the same spot. Her training was very positive.
Excellent professional! A true display of competence!!!
Congratulations Teca for the excellent work you do with the furry ones! Zucca thanks you for all the affection and guidance that helped her become more social. Thank you!

She was extremely important when we welcomed Brutus into our lives.
In a single consultation, she helped us understand how we could have a smooth transition and adaptation with Brutus as a puppy.
Today we still follow her advice, tips, and teachings. I remember her talking to my daughter, who was 12 years old at the time, about the responsibilities of having a puppy and how she would train him.
We are eternally grateful.

I recommend Teca without hesitation!
She is a very responsible and dedicated professional!
She understands animal behavior very well and helped me a lot with my dog's interaction with my daughter. I recommend her!
Wonderful work! A highly competent, trustworthy, and studious professional with extensive experience in handling animals.
When our dog Mel entered adulthood, between one and a half and two years old, she began to exhibit aggressive behavior towards some dogs on the street. That's when we called Teca. …

I had my dogs trained by Teca Marinho, she was highly recommended by several people and by our veterinarian.
She is an excellent professional, very up-to-date and competent! …
Great experience, I recommend it! With an approach based on positive techniques and a lot of patience, it transforms the behavior of dogs.
Uncomplicated training can solve any issue related to animal behavior. It's impressive.
Teca is great! Excellent approach, direct, clear, greatly improves communication between the owner and their dog.
Teca is AMAZING! She had already trained my sister's West Highland White Terrier, and she already had an excellent recommendation and trained my Bull Terrier! I highly recommend her! 😉 …
